# ProjectedSphericalHarmonics.jl

> Julia package for integral equations on flat open surfaces (the unit disk, ellipses, and domains bounded by a smooth curve, in the plane z = 0) by projected spherical harmonics (PSH) y_ℓ^m(r, θ) = N_ℓ^m P_ℓ^|m|(√(1−r²)) e^{imθ}: even PSH (ℓ+m even) are polynomials, odd ones are w·polynomials with w = √(1−r²), so densities with the edge behavior 1/w (single layer) or w (hypersingular) converge spectrally. On the disk, 𝒮[y/w] = (λ_ℓ^m/4) y (even) and 𝒩[y] = −y/(λ_ℓ^m w) (odd). Angular kernels g(φ)/|x−y| are sparse in coefficient space (in-plane Stokes, ellipses); mapped domains (harmonic or conformal maps of the disk) use singularity swapping (dense). Many-body Stokes suspensions of disks or ellipses: GMRES with a block-diagonal preconditioner, cross terms by Ewald + NUFFT (FINUFFT) or FMM3D, closed-form close evaluation.

Source: not registered; `Pkg.add(url = "https://github.com/scottweady/ProjectedSphericalHarmonics.jl")`, Julia ≥ 1.12. Start Julia with threads for suspensions.

User API: discretizations `disk(Mℓ, Mₘ)` / `disk(M)` (grid (Mℓ+1) × (2Mₘ+1): Gauss–Legendre in s = √(1−r²), equispaced θ; fields `D.z` points as complex, `D.dz` area weights, `D.w`, `D.Mspan`, `D.even`, `D.odd`), `ellipse(a, b, M)`, `domain(γ, M; map=:auto|:harmonic|:winslow|:conformal)` (experimental; γ: counterclockwise equispaced boundary samples; auto (default): harmonic, or Winslow (with an @info) where harmonic folds; harmonic: harmonic extension of the samples, the parametrization places the grid, one-to-one for convex curves (folds are an ArgumentError), no 𝒩; winslow: inverse map harmonic, one-to-one for non-convex shapes, seconds to build, needs |μ| < 1 between grid points (ArgumentError), no 𝒩; conformal: origin inside, not checked, crowds on elongated shapes; dense, moderate M); functions are arrays of grid values or numbers, vector fields tuples `(ux, uy)`. Basis: `ylm(ℓ, m, z)`, `λlm`, `Nlm`, `Clmn`, `psh(u, D; parity=:even|:odd)`, `ipsh`, `psh!`, `ipsh!` (coefficients `[ℓ+1, j]` for m = `D.Mspan[j]`), `upsample`, `trace` (values on the rim), `ipsh(û, D, ζ)` (values at complex points ζ of the reference disk, clamped to |ζ| ≤ 1), `ipsh_matrix(D, ζ; parity)` (basis values, columns in the order of `D.idx_even` for :even), `mode_orders(D; parity)` (m of each column), `integral(u, Ω)` (a tuple gives the tuple of its components' integrals). Laplace: `𝒮(u, Ω)` (u = g/w), `𝒮⁻¹(f, Ω)` (returns g/w; `𝒮⁻¹(1, disk)` = 4/(πw)), `𝒩(u, Ω)` (u = w g), `𝒩⁻¹`, `𝒮𝒩⁻¹` (Δ of it is the identity), `Δ⁻¹(f, g, D)` Poisson with Dirichlet data; volume potentials `𝒱(u, D)` (log kernel /2π, smooth u, spectral; `𝒱(x, u, D)` at any points incl. outside), `𝒯_vol(u, D)`, `𝒯_vol(x, u, D)` (|x−y|/8π, smooth u), `ℬ(u, D; κ)`, `𝒯` (|x−y|/8π, u = g/w); shape derivatives `δ𝒮(u, m, D)`, `δ𝒩`, `δ𝒱`, `δℬ` (deformation ζ ↦ ζ + εζ^{m+1}; real-ε derivative = (δ𝒮(u) + conj δ𝒮(ū))/2); disk-only differential operators `∂ζ`, `∂ζ̄`, `∂x`, `∂y`, `grad`, `div`, `lap` (ill-conditioned), `∂n`. Stokes (G = (I/|r| + rrᵀ/|r|³)/(4π(μ_bottom+μ_top)); keywords μ_bottom=1, μ_top=0 = half-space under a stress-free surface; equal = free space): `𝒮_st(f, Ω)`, `𝒮_st⁻¹(u, Ω)`, `𝒮_st(tgt, f, Ω)` off the body, `stokes_mobility_matrix(Ω)` (3×3 resistance), `stokes_mobility_solve(uinf, uslip, F, Ω; M) -> (U, ω)`. Normal forces (free space only, keyword μ = fluid viscosity; μ_bottom/μ_top rejected): `𝒮_st((fx, fy, fz), Ω; μ)` → (ux, uy, uz) with uz = 𝒮[fz]/(2μ), `𝒮_st⁻¹((ux, uy, uz), Ω; μ)`, `stokes_normal_mobility_matrix(Ω; μ)` (Uz, Ωx, Ωy; disk: diag(16, 32/3, 32/3)μ), `stokes_mobility_solve((ux, uy, uz), uslip, [Fx, Fy, Fz, Tx, Ty, Tz], Ω; μ, M, Mn) -> ((Ux, Uy, Uz), (Ωx, Ωy, Ωz))`; 2-tuples and 3-component F unchanged. Suspensions (every body a copy of Ω at `xcm[i]` (complex), rotated by `θcm[i]`): `suspension_mobility_solve(xcm, θcm, uinf, uslip, F, Ω; eps, gmrestol, method=:ewald|:fmm, close_eval=true, close_radius, M, S_self, μ_bottom, μ_top) -> (f, U)` (U world frame [Ux, Uy, ω]; f body frame), `suspension_velocity_eval`, `suspension_velocity_solve`, `suspension_self_matrix(Ω)` (build M and S_self once per simulation). Utilities: `gmres(L!, f)`, `aca`, `apply`, `solve`, `legpts`, `trigpts`, `psh_matrix`, `ipsh_matrix`, `lm2index`, `index2lm`.

## Docs

- Home: what it does, one call, what it offers
- Getting started: installation, a discretization, transforms, Laplace layer potentials, Poisson, non-circular domains, Stokes flow and viscosities, one-body mobility, suspensions and what to precompute
- Method: overview and validation; the PSH basis (parity, grid, transforms, differentiation); Laplace operators (eigenvalues, Poisson, volume potentials, shape derivatives); Stokes flow (angular kernels, mobility of one body); non-circular domains (ellipses, conformal maps, costs); suspensions (formulation, Ewald, self matrix, close evaluation, preconditioner, costs); limits
- Examples: scripts checked against exact solutions
- API reference: every exported name
- Code map: which functions each feature runs, and the layout of src/
